message: Magic Control Pro v2.0: added Notes at /notes, updated Calculator/Notes Home Screen icons, and optimized embedded icon assets to preserve the OTA partition limit.
notes: Calculator remains at /calc. Notes sends the full non-empty note through the existing local-command optimizer on Done or, when enabled, on app exit/phone lock with ESP32 heartbeat fallback. Embedded Calculator and Notes PNG assets are palette-optimized without changing their routes or dimensions.
